Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study used a 'Pitchfork' strategy consisting of four parallel methods. Three of these (SPEG, N-glyco-FASP, and hpTC) specifically isolated and enriched membrane fractions or membrane-associated peptides using affinity-based capture (hydrazide beads and lectins) or hydrophobic segment extraction. While one method (SDC-Trypsin) used a standard tissue lysate, the core objective and the majority of the analyzed material were purified membrane fractions.
